examples.english: Grandma is delighted looking at photos of her great-grandchild.

examples.japanese: {九十歳|きゅうじゅっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{曽孫|ひまご}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{四世代|よんせだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Four generations, from children to great-grandchildren, gathered for the ninetieth-birthday celebration.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
- Usually ひまご; also read そうそん in formal writing. Also written ひ{孫|まご} or {曾孫|ひまご}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧: grandchild
- ⟦{曽祖父|そうそふ}→曽祖父：31248_sousofu⟧ / ⟦{曽祖母|そうそぼ}→曽祖母：31265_sousobo⟧: great-grandfather / great-grandmother
- The prefix ひ〜 marks the generation beyond: ひい⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ (great-grandfather) is the everyday counterpart of ⟦{曽祖父|そうそふ}→曽祖父：31248_sousofu⟧.
